svg.title: Step 7 mockup 17 · Mini tournaments for the crew: the queue, what runs, rules for one game, settings (crew, organiser)
svg.text: 17 · Mini tournaments for the crew: the queue, what runs, rules for one game, settings (crew, organiser)
Use case: on Saturday evening four mini tournaments are on beside the cup; the crew settles a dispute, confirms a lone report and starts one for a game the catalogue has no rules for
The Tournament page, Mini tournaments tab, at 1920 px

g.text: Demo Game Cup · 3 mini tournaments live · 1 open for sign-up
Players start their own from the hub; the crew can start one for any game.
Crew Lead settled Demo Arena 1v1, round 2: Player Two first; the two reports differed
Demo Racer heats started with 9 players; the draw can be replayed
Player Four opened Demo Arena 1v1, sign-up until 22:00
No rules in the catalogue yet
Set here for this tournament only

svg.text: Settings, Mini tournaments (part of the Settings tab)
Players start mini tournaments from a game's page or Play.
A cap on mini tournaments at once
Off: one open sign-up per game at a time.
Differing reports, a lone report after 10 minutes and problem notes reach one queue (M8, M9).
The crew picks a report or drags the teams into order; each decision is kept in the history (M9).
Mini tournaments are cards at card size, the crew band above (amendment 3); the history stays a table.
The phone is the same page reflowed at 390 px (U14); cancel needs the crew's right (M14, M15).
A game without catalogue rules: the crew sets them for this one tournament, never back into the catalogue (M2, D19).
Who may start one and the cap are event settings; ratings change marks are on by default (M1, M4, O11).
